description: Defines the metrics_manager class, which manages registration, notification, and periodic reporting of metrics within the ocudu::app_services namespace. It includes methods for handling new metrics, starting/stopping reporting, and maintains internal data structures for metrics entries.

classes.name: metrics_manager
classes.description: Manages metrics registration, notification, and periodic reporting within the application service.

methods.name: metrics_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the metrics manager with logger, executor, metrics info, timers, and report period.

methods.name: on_new_metric
methods.description: Handles incoming metrics, forwarding to subscribers if registered.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic metrics report controller.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic metrics report controller and the stop event source.
